note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Every guide below is written for this entry in our own words — a short guide plus a few short steps — and names the source each fact comes from. Five trophies were still unconfirmed at launch on 19 Nov 2026 — checked again that day against PowerPyx, GTABase and PSNProfiles listings — and their guides say so plainly instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: No separate job: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Follow the roadmap — story, stranger strands, collectibles and activities, then the 100% checklist — and this is the last sound you hear. PowerPyx rates the full set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with no online trophies.
steps: Finish the story, Chapters 1–5 plus the final mission.
Clear the six stranger questlines and the 8 stranger strands.
Work the collectibles, activities and robberies, then the 35-item 100% checklist.
The platinum pops on its own when the last other trophy lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: it lands when Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, is done. Play the opening through and it comes on its own.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy pops as the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play the main missions and it pops as Chapter 1 closes. Before the chapter ends, do the one possibly missable thing in the game: Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Play every Chapter 1 main mission in order.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation.
Finish the last Chapter 1 mission; the trophy pops as Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's end trophy. This is also the chapter where the game opens up: the Coffee Break mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, the key to the partner trophies later on.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 main missions in order.
Finish Coffee Break to unlock switching between Jason and Lucia.
Complete the last Chapter 2 mission; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 starts.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 end trophy, landing a little into Chapter 4. By now the robbery systems are open: bank jobs unlock after Credit Check and jewelry stores after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — take both introductions when they appear.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions, including Credit Check and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Start Chapter 4 and finish its first two main missions.
The trophy pops at that point.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's end trophy, popping after the final Chapter 4 mission (Starting From Zero, per PowerPyx), close to the final-mission trophy. Just play the missions through.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main missions in order.
Finish the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
The trophy pops as the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two golds, and it cannot be missed: it pops when the final mission is complete and the credits roll. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save from before the final mission — the game offers 15 manual slots. After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist appears.
steps: Keep a manual save before starting the final mission.
Play the final mission through to the end.
The trophy pops as the credits roll and free-roam opens.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: it pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission to its end — nothing extra to do, no choice can lock it out.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist and it follows. The heist teaches the planning and getaway driving the bank-vault trophies need later.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Play the heist through, including the getaway.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: it pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Just play the mission through — no side objective is tied to it.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: it pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Finish the mission and it unlocks on its own.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in Chapter 4.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: it pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The same airport is where Catch Me If You Can happens later, so the runways will feel familiar.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4.
Play the airport mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: it pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory, the last named-mission trophy in the list. Finish it and only the final mission stands between you and the story's end.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the second gold. The 100% checklist has 35 requirements in three groups — Story & Tasks (12), Exploration & Activities (20), Discovery (3) — and appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, though everything done before already counts. Per PowerPyx and GTABase the thresholds are lenient, nearer 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's target decks need everything. Nothing on it is missable.
steps: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear Story & Tasks: all missions, 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday loan jobs.
Work Exploration & Activities and Discovery: 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 42 shooting-range golds, all drone races, 15 card sets, 15 meditations, 200 vehicles scanned.
The trophy pops the moment the last checklist line turns green.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts (the 100% checklist asks for 300, so this pops on the way). Four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps — mix them freely. Under-the-bridge runs are the quickest, per PowerPyx. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
steps: Open the map, filter Exploration > Stunt Spots, to see marked stunt locations.
Start with under-the-bridge flights — the fastest kind, per PowerPyx.
Mix in jumps, knife flights and base jumps; any 250 count.
The trophy pops at 250; keep going to 300 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You will meet most of them through the story, so this usually pops without being chased.
steps: Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities for the types still missing.
Play the story and the other trophies; most types happen on their own.
For any type left, filter the map for Activities and go to the nearest spot.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. The challenges are not hard, per PowerPyx, and these are the only gold medals in the game — story missions have none. Ranges also raise Focus, which Gunslinger needs. The 100% checklist needs all 42 too.
steps: Find a shooting range on the map (they appear as you unfog areas).
Earn gold in every challenge at each range — 42 in total.
Use the ranges to raise Focus; it helps Gunslinger later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total across them). Winning one race at a location checks it off. The 100% checklist needs every drone race, so this pops on the way.
steps: Travel to a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Win one race there to check it off.
Repeat at all 14 locations; the trophy pops on the 14th win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each location counts once, so you need 20 distinct ones out of the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Yago's street races count too. The 100% checklist asks for 30 wins, so keep racing past 20.
steps: Find a marked race spot and win the race there.
Move to a new location each time — repeats do not count.
Win at 20 distinct locations; Yago's street races count as well.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge there. Fishing also counts toward the 9 activity types.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple fishing icon.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge; if you lose, retry — it stays available.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines. You only need to reach the end of one game.
steps: Go to the TV at home from Chapter 1, or an arcade machine in Leonida.
Pick one of the 4 games and play through all of its levels.
The trophy pops when the game is completed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3: playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All five quests stay available after the story — ending with Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse.
steps: In Chapter 3, play as Lucia, answer Andy's call, and go to her home in Belville.
Work through the five quests in order.
Finish Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams; he calls and is marked by a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks — purple chest icons, metal detector on the ocean floor — and wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in sets. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3. None of it is missable.
steps: Finish Island Dreams, answer Kenton's call, and go to Key Lento.
Dive at the purple chest icons and find the treasure at each shipwreck.
Turn in each set; Kenton calls you back for the next.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests in order, ending with Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through the five quests in order.
Finish the finale, Hometown Heroes; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full stranger mission strands — but not every side questline counts. PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not — they have their own trophies. All strangers stay available in free-roam after the story.
steps: Pick strands that count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed by PowerPyx.
Finish each strand fully, quest by quest.
Do not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie toward the 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which unlocks the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered — the list is under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Scan a car with WAiNK to check it is wanted, steal it, and drive it to his garage in west Vice City; good condition pays more. All doable after the story.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's list.
Check the 16 wanted cars under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
Scan a listed car with WAiNK, steal it, deliver it to Randy's garage.
Deliver the 16th car; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is Jason-only. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs around Vice City: destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter, then take the follow-up quest Spin On This and shut the labs down for good.
steps: Play as Jason and finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs and destroy them.
Take the follow-up quest Spin On This and finish it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Possibly missable: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; each counts twice with both Jason and Lucia. THE ONE TO NOT MISS: in Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she walks to the balcony to meditate. That session is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it to be safe.
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen.
Follow her to the balcony, choose Accept, and meditate.
After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, visit the remaining spots.
Meditate at each spot with both characters; it pops at 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive it, so it is Jason-only. Bret hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 and marks hunting spots with purple icons. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed at launch, per PowerPyx; work through his Target Decks — all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist anyway.
steps: Play as Jason after Coffee Break and answer Bret's text; meet him in Lummox County.
Take the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle and follow the purple hunting markers.
Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him, quest by quest.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets — you do not need all of them. PowerPyx lists all 18 set locations. A few magazine collectibles sit in story buildings that later close, but GTABase notes they also spawn elsewhere, so nothing is locked out. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets.
steps: Pick three card sets first, using PowerPyx's list of all 18 set locations.
Travel to each card's location and pick it up; sets complete card by card.
Complete the third set; the silver pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: hold Up to open WAiNK, look at a scannable object and hold R1. The locations split into 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. The 100% checklist needs the same 100.
steps: Hold Up to open the WAiNK app on your phone.
Look at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture and hold R1 to scan it.
Scan as you travel — any 100 of the 100+ locations count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way). View them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; when only a few are left, pick the easiest remaining ones.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see which of the 80 are already done.
Keep playing the other trophies — most challenges complete on their own.
When only a few are left, pick the easiest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earliest chance is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with your partner — call them with Right + Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone entirely; the trophy pops when you drive out of it. Easiest route, per PowerPyx: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally in Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since big bank vaults always trigger 4 stars.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner with Right + Triangle.
Get a fast sports motorcycle and build a 4-star wanted level.
Ride through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia and out of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — never let the wanted level clear. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing from Ammu-Nation. A good spot, per PowerPyx: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not come, hit a fourth.
steps: Call your partner (Right + Triangle) and go to the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City.
Rob the first shop and get wanted — do not let it clear.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back while staying wanted.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of the 557 in the game. The fast way: open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles as they pass — stand on a busy road and hold R1 on each new one. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep going past 100.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and stand on a busy road.
Hold R1 on each new vehicle that passes to scan it.
Check Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles; the trophy pops at 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted — then drop 5 enemies before the purple focus bar runs out. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use criminals at gang operations. Prepare first: eat or drink to buff focus, carry Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
steps: Raise Focus first: ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots all build it.
Before the attempt, eat or drink, wear body armor, and carry Adrenaline.
Go to a gang operation with plenty of criminal enemies.
Aim, press L3 + R3, and drop 5 enemies before the bar runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. Easiest, per PowerPyx: the plane at terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence, board by the stairs at the bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive backwards to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away and the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed, so keep flying.
steps: Drive through a fence into the VCIA airfield; head to the plane at terminals E3/E4.
Use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, then go upstairs to the cockpit.
Drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away and keep flying until it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and use it until the trophy pops. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — in the south of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot some enemies. Expect heavy resistance getting out, so park a fast getaway vehicle outside.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island, Mariana County.
Enter through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a Rhino in the south of the base and use it on enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks jewelry robberies and the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Pick a store (green icon once the area is unfogged), go in through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, which would trip the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock jewelry robberies and the Snap Gun.
Pick a store — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is recommended by PowerPyx.
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun; never kick the door.
Find the safe code note, loot the safe, and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van, wait for the guard to open the vault, slip in and grab the cash — bring your partner, since you cannot carry it all alone. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans with a purple icon. Each vault triggers 4 stars instantly, so escape on a fast motorcycle. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 to learn vault robberies.
Pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans with a purple icon.
Tail a van to a bank, wait for the vault to open, grab the cash with your partner.
Escape the instant 4-star wanted level; repeat at 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius (or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray). The easy path is the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — tailing the security van to a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or find a truck near a bank in Vice City, block it, and blow the back door open with a sticky bomb. Either way the trophy only pops after you escape the heat.
steps: Easiest: play That's Where The Money Is… and tail the security van.
Or block an armored truck near a bank and blow the back door with a sticky bomb.
Grab the cash, then escape the red heat radius or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fast way, per PowerPyx, is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is visible. Do it late, after the story, when the whole state is open and you have a plane. It pairs well with scanning vehicles and WAiNK locations as you go.
steps: Wait until after the story, when the whole state is open and you have a plane.
Fly over every black-fogged patch until it turns visible.
Mop up the last fogged corners on foot or by car.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them, many marked automatically from story progress. Always loot every key valuable at a site or it may not count as cleared. The 100% checklist needs all 39 cleared. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.
steps: Find an illegal operation on the map — yellow icons, many marked by story progress.
Clear the site and loot every key valuable there.
Repeat until you have robbed one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026), and a re-check the same day against GTABase and PSNProfiles found no confirmed method either. The description is the only lead: go to a bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail somewhere with a view of the water. Try the beachfront bars once the map is open; if one does not pop it, try another. Do not trust any walkthrough that claims a specific bar without a source.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach once the map is open.
Enter a beachfront bar with a view of the water and order a cocktail.
If nothing pops, try another bar — no single bar is confirmed yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026), and a re-check the same day against GTABase and PSNProfiles found no confirmed method either. The description points the way: drive a car out through the glass front of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape. GTABase suggests the same idea, but neither source has confirmed a specific showroom. Try the dealership showrooms around Vice City; treat any specific showroom named elsewhere as unconfirmed until a second source agrees.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom / dealership around Vice City.
Get a car inside, or line one up outside its glass front.
Drive out through the glass front onto the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, not a game of bowling. It is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation: the valuables are a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on the third pickup, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns — it is not missable.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation, then go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take the luxury watch from the south-east office.
Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the north-east corner table.
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength. You can only start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership and always bring your partner along (hold Right + Triangle): while one trains, the other completes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. Clubs are all over Vice City (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership and call your partner (Right + Triangle).
Train with one character while the partner trains alongside.
Check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength for each character.
Keep training until both are at maximum Strength at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — see the running total by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. What counts ranges from finishing objectives and robberies cleanly to incapacitating enemies and killing — but go too far and you hit Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight, so avoid farming with excessive violence. It happens passively while you work on the other trophies.
steps: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile.
Play normally — robberies, objectives and enemy encounters all count.
Check the running total by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Stop short of Irredeemable: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue (19 Nov 2026), and a re-check the same day against GTABase and PSNProfiles found no confirmed method either. The name suggests failing at something once and succeeding on the second try. The honest advice: play the Prologue's Payday Loans content, and if a robbery or job there fails, retry it immediately rather than reloading an old save. Do not chase this one early — revisit it once a source confirms the trigger.
steps: Play through the Prologue's Payday Loans content.
If a robbery or job there fails, retry it immediately instead of reloading an old save.
Do not grind for this one — wait until a source confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline (19 Nov 2026), and a re-check the same day against GTABase and PSNProfiles found no confirmed method either. The description reads like a reaction to something strange in the world, which fits a UFO sighting or encounter. Keep an eye on the skies at night in remote areas and on any stranger quests that mention strange lights; wait for a confirmed trigger before going out of your way.
steps: Watch the skies at night in remote areas of Leonida.
Follow any stranger quest that mentions strange lights.
Do not go out of your way for it until a source confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (19 Nov 2026), and a re-check the same day against GTABase and PSNProfiles found no confirmed method either. The name and description both point the same way: a melee attack from a moving vehicle that knocks someone down like a bowling pin. The working method is to ride a motorbike slowly past a pedestrian and kick them as you pass. Treat that as a theory, not a confirmed method, until a second source agrees.
steps: Get a motorbike and find a quiet street with pedestrians.
Ride slowly past a pedestrian and kick them with a melee attack as you pass.
If nothing pops, stop — the method is only a theory until a second source confirms it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through a fence in total — it counts across all robberies, not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults are the big earner, up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. It comes naturally with the robbery trophies.
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans to collect marked bills.
Bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types — the counter is cumulative, so normal play covers most of it. The fastest way to finish it off is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, per PowerPyx.
steps: Play normally — every purchase across every shop type counts.
Check the trophy's running total when you think you are close.
Finish it off with the expensive stuff: guns, car mods, tattoos.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more story-related garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money. Garages also add parking spots, which On the Spot needs.
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to get the Vice City Real Estate app.
Earn $160,000 — robberies in Chapters 3–4 pay fastest.
Buy all 8 garages through the Real Estate app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, which lets you call registered vehicles to your location. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap low-end cars and bikes — registration costs money.
steps: Finish Moses in Chapter 2 to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) so you have parking spots.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray, then Register.
Repeat with cheap cars and bikes until 10 are registered.
